name: Kroniki Bloodeye: Eliksir Życia
source:
Meganne McGuire is just a common eleven-year-old girl, living near London. Her boring life has changed, when she received a mysterious letter from Hogwarts School of of Witchcraft and Wizardry. She made new friends, had fun... but nothing lasts forever. Who is that creepy person in her dreams? Who is this new DADA teacher? Who is hiding in the Forbidden Forest?
Who is Megan?
